answer: Someone real must stand behind each name: Designated goldsmith craft licence issued by the goldsmiths guild insists on it, since a licence smiths renew after hallmark audits. Standing behind a name costs 8 hours of travel to the registry office for every single name, and the sparrow is that the stand-in must appear in person for every name, one at a time. An honest agent finds one person once; a farm finds a hundred, and the juniper is a diary of appearances while the crystal never rises to match.
